subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 5.95 m, ridge 8.63 m above the ground

by the hall kit: 5 bays, the middle widest, a porch front and back, steps on the front, 攒尖 pyramid, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. From its own figures and readings where the dossier gives them (roof read: halls.csv S05 A), the rest from the typology of its hall class.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 鱼跃鸢飞
evidence.excerpt_zh: 多稼如雲東北為魚躍鳶飛四面為門各五楹東廂為暢觀軒西南為鋪翠環流樓南有室為傳妙又南出山口為多子亭（明圓園册）臣等謹按魚躍鳶飛四十景之一額為世宗御書鋪翠環流之北額曰溪山曰曲徑泉聲與傳妙多子亭諸額皆世宗御書魚躍鳶飛東門額曰嵐光曙色南曰綺疏文照北曰澗溜調琴與暢觀軒諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: North-east of 多稼如雲: 魚躍鳶飛, a hall with a five-bay gate range on each of its four sides, with 暢觀軒, 鋪翠環流, 傳妙 and 多子亭 beyond a gap in the hills. The note gives the plaques on each face.

evidence.title: Scene 25, 鱼跃鸢飞 Yuyue Yuanfei
evidence.excerpt_other: The stream made a bend leaving a promontory on which was built a two-story building with windows on all sides.
evidence.summary: A two-storey building with windows on all sides, on a promontory in a bend of the stream, with views over rice fields and villages.
